content: Diataxis framework (recommended by Scientific Python Development Guide): tutorials (learning-oriented, guided steps), how-to guides (task-oriented, assumes knowledge), reference (API, factual), explanation (conceptual understanding). Statsmodels: IPython notebooks + plain Python scripts, dual format. Worked examples should mix code+results+text, state random seeds for reproducibility, document dependencies. Problem→Data→Method→Interpretation narrative is the gold standard.
